items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1959-12-09
items.q: I said, yeah, tie my tie for him. I tied a tie for him, you know, and look in the glass, he looked at me. He said, that's fine, that's just fine. And on his hand, his pocket, give me $5.

ctx.x: I said, all right. Say, I guess you boys, we won't see y'all until the head report up at the Greenwald Hotel, used to call the roads at the Greenwald. Report every morning because they didn't know exactly when they'd leave, you see. They didn't want us to get mixed up. So, I come out on the platform and this fellow, I tell him, old man, Miles, he didn't know how to tie his necktie, you know. He wanted to tie it like this. And you see him, I'm tired, yeah. He said, can you tie that boy? I said, yeah, tie my tie…
